text: Be mindful of monthly upload limits — 60MB for free accounts and 1024 MB for Premium. Digital photos, especially from higher resolution cameras, can chew up bandwidth. For example, 6MP images with low compression allow for only about 464 pictures per GB. In months when you’re on vacation and may be taking lots of high-resolution pictures, you may want to increase your upload allowance, 1GB at a time, with a limit of 5 increases in one month and up to 25 additional gigabytes in a single year. You can easily check usage by clicking Settings in Evernote Web and looking at Usage. Click Increase Upload Allowance to add more bandwidth.
